# Terms of service
## Please read these terms and conditions carefully. By using our site and services you agree to be bound by the terms and conditions listed in the following points. It is your responsibility, the user, customers or prospective customer to read the terms and conditions before proceeding to use our site or services.
### Terms of use
We may revise these terms and conditions page at any time. You are expected to check this page regularly to take notice of any changes we make, as they are binding on you.
These terms and conditions ("Agreement") sets forth the general terms and conditions of your use of the [api-football.com](https://www.api-football.com/) website ("Website" or "Service") and any of its related products and services (collectively, "Services").

...

### Accounts and membership
In case of a formal complaint or legal notice from a recognized rights holder (such as a league, federation, or event organizer) regarding the use of our data by a client, we reserve the right to immediately suspend or terminate the client's access to the API, without refund, in order to comply with legal obligations and protect the integrity of our services.

...

### Subscription
To subscribe to our API you can either pass:
With us direclty on our dashboard (dashboard.api-football.com)
With RapidApi (rapidapi.com) _(In the case, you must create an account on their platform. They are in charge of your access and the management of payments)_
RapidAPI is an API Marketplace through which you can subscribe to our API, in this case they are in charge of your account, your payments and your access to the API.
API data are the same regardless of the subscription chosen.
**The terms of payment, renewal and cancellation are not the same depending on the method of subscription to our API.**

### Plans & Payments
**SUBSCRIPTION ON RAPIDAPI.COM :**
Prices are based on a recurring monthly subscription based on the plan selected and overage fees may be applied when a user that exceeds a plan’s quota limits. It is important to read and understand a plan's limit before subscribing.
Your access to the API is automatically renewed every month on the day of your subscription.
**Daily Quota Limit Reset :**
_The daily quota period starts at your time of subscription and ends 24 hours from that time. For instance, if you subscribed to our API at 11:30:15 UTC on June 2, your daily quota will reset at 11:30:15 UTC each day._
**Unsubscribing and resubscribing**
Charges once a subscription is made. If you subscribe to Example API's PRO plan, unsubscribe, then re-subscribe to Example API's PRO plan again, you would be charged twice.
**SUBSCRIPTION ON DASHBOARD.API-FOOTBALL.COM :**
Subscriptions on our dashboard are prepaid access to the API for a period agreed between the user and Api-football.
Users who have opted for prepaid payment by paypal or credit card, will have access to the API for the period that has been agreed.
Once the defined period has expired, your access to the API will be switched to the free plan. You can re-subscribe at any time from the dashboard.
**Daily Quota Limit Reset :**
_The daily quota period starts at 00:00:00 UTC. For instance, if you subscribed to our API at 11:30:15 UTC on June 2, your daily quota will reset at 00:00:00 UTC each day. **Unused requests are lost** ._
**Rate Limiting Policy :**
Failure to comply with the per-minute rate limits associated with your subscription plan, including but not limited to abusive, disproportionate, or excessive request patterns, constitutes a material breach of these Terms of Service.
In such cases, the Provider reserves the right, at its sole discretion and without prior notice, to implement automatic suspensions through its firewalls, impose temporary or permanent access restrictions, or terminate the account. No refund, credit, or compensation of any kind shall be due in the event of such suspension, restriction, or termination. These measures are necessary to preserve the stability, security, and integrity of the Service for all users.

...

### Overages
**SUBSCRIPTION ON RAPIDAPI.COM :**
An overage ensues when you go over a quota for your API plan.
It is your responsibility to review and monitor for the plan’s usage limitations. You are required to keep track of your quota usage to prevent overages. You can do this by tracking the number of API calls you make and checking the rapidApi dashboard for up-to-date usage statistics.
**No refund can be requested for these costs.**

...

### Upgrade/downgrade API plans
**SUBSCRIPTION ON DASHBOARD.API-FOOTBALL.COM :**
You can change the Plan directly on the dashboard at any time.
By upgrading to another plan, only the plan and the number of requests per day will be updated, the end date of your subscription will remain the same. You only pay the price difference between the two plans minus what you already used on the old plan.
The plan upgrades take into account the discounts obtained during your subscription and the same discount is applied when calculating the price.
Plan upgrades are final and it is not possible to downgrade to a smaller plan.

### Update API pricing plans
We can may occasionally update our pricing plans.
However, you will remain subscribed to the version of the plan you were subscribed to.
We do this to protect developers and make sure that the terms and conditions that they had agreed to do not change.
If you do want to subscribe to the most recent plan, you would need to unsubscribe from your plan and then re-subscribe to the new plan.

...

### Data/Logos/images
Logos, images and trademarks delivered through the API are provided solely for identification and descriptive purposes (e.g., identifying leagues, teams, players or venues). They are provided free of charge and are not counted against your API usage quota. We does not own any of these visual assets, and no intellectual property rights are claimed over them.

...

### Chat Support
Available only on our dashboard, this tool provided by "Smartsupp" allows you to contact us directly by Chat.
Paid users have access to this tool from Monday to Friday, 7AM to 4PM UTC.
Response times may vary and are not guaranteed in terms of SLA.
Any lack of respect towards one of our support members will not be tolerated and will result in the blocking of access to the support tool.

results.title: API FAQ
results.content:
> For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/llms.txt). Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to page URLs; this page is available as [Markdown](https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/api-faq.md).

# API FAQ
Answers to common questions about the Sportmonks Football API v3, including access, coverage, odds, integration and troubleshooting.

...

## Getting started and migration
### Why was API 3.0 introduced, and why should I migrate?
API 3.0 introduces a data model designed to support more sports and continued product development. Existing API 2 integrations should follow the [API 2 and API 3 comparison](https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/welcome/differences-between-api-2-and-api-3) when planning migration.

...

## Data and coverage
### Why can I access fewer players than in API 2.0?
API 3 access is based on players who have played for teams covered by your plan. API 2 could include inactive, duplicate or non-existing player records, so raw totals are not a reliable migration comparison.

### What is the difference between Standard and Advanced statistics?
Standard and Advanced core-statistics packages describe the previous pricing model. Under the current setup, core statistics are included across paid base plans; plans scale by league capacity and API usage. Separate add-ons such as xG still have their own tiers. Check league-level coverage and your active subscription before relying on a statistic.
See the current pricing announcement: https://www.sportmonks.com/blogs/introducing-our-new-pricing-setup/

...

## Odds
### When do odds become available?
Standard Bet365 and Premium prices can appear about three weeks ahead; other Standard bookmakers typically about two weeks ahead. Timing varies by bookmaker and event.

...

### What are winning odds?
The `winning` flag identifies a winning selection. It is supported for Standard pre-match odds. A default `false` value alone does not establish that a selection has been settled as a loss.

...

## Integration and development
### How does pagination work?
Read the response's pagination metadata and continue while more results are available. Do not assume the first page contains everything or rely on a total page count. Respect the page-size limit of the endpoint. See [Pagination](https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/tutorials-and-guides/tutorials/introduction/pagination).

### What is the difference between includes and selects?
`include` adds related data; `select` limits fields on the base entity. Request only what the application needs and check the endpoint's supported relationships and fields.

...

## Billing and plans
### What is the difference between plans?
Compare league allowances, data access, add-ons, request limits and billing terms on the [Football API pricing page](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/#plans-pricing). Check MySportmonks for the entitlements attached to your subscription.

### Is there a Free plan or a trial?
The [current plan reference](https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/api/rate-limit) lists a Free plan for the Danish Superliga and Scottish Premiership, with no expiry or credit card requirement, and a 14-day paid-plan trial with no credit card required upfront. Check the signup flow for the applicable terms.

### Can I cancel, and is annual billing available?
Manage your subscription in MySportmonks. Check the current cancellation, renewal and annual billing terms before changing your plan. Contact sales@sportmonks.com if you need help choosing a billing option.

...

## Still have questions?
Contact support@sportmonks.com with the affected endpoint, fixture or league IDs, HTTP status and a redacted example. Never include your API token.

...

# Agent Instructions
## Querying This Documentation
```
GET https://docs.sportmonks.com/v3/api-faq.md?ask=<question>&goal=<user_goal>
```

results.title: Sportmonks integrity support: GDPR, security & data use
results.content:
# Where our data comes from, how we protect it, and what you may do with it
This is the page for the questions that come up before anyone signs anything. How sports data is collected and checked, what happens when a number is wrong, how we handle personal data under GDPR, how the API is monitored, and what our terms actually allow you to build.

...

## How a number gets from a stadium into your app
### Being straight about rights and partners
We do not claim to hold official rights on behalf of leagues or competitions, and we do not present partner data as our own collection. Coverage detail sits on the [coverage pages](https://www.sportmonks.com/football-api/coverage/) .

### Club logos and player photos are a separate question
Images that reach you through the API are convenience, not a licence. Our [terms of service](https://www.sportmonks.com/terms-of-service/) put the responsibility on you to hold your own rights for any logo or profile photo you display, or to use your own variation instead.

...

## What happens when a number is wrong
No sports data feed is right every single time, and our [terms of service](https://www.sportmonks.com/terms-of-service/) do not pretend otherwise: we do not guarantee completeness or accuracy at all times. Any provider claiming they do is telling you something about their honesty, not their data.

...

1. You report it
Email [support@sportmonks.com](mailto:support@sportmonks.com) , or go straight to your personal contact if you are on a paid plan. The fastest report includes the fixture or entity ID, the endpoint you called, what you saw and what you expected. Median first reply is under two hours in working hours, 7 days a week.
2. We trace it back to the source
Every value has a provenance: our own collection, or a named partner feed.

...

## How the API is secured, and what we have not certified
### Access and authentication
Access is by API token, provisioned instantly at signup and tied to your account. You generate and replace your own tokens in my.sportmonks without asking us. Tokens are the credential, so how you store them matters as much as how we issue them.

...

### What we have not done
We do not hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification today, and we will not imply otherwise on a page about integrity. What we do instead: answer your security questionnaire directly, with a named person, in days rather than quarters. Median first reply to any support question is under two hours.

...

## What you may do with the data, in plain words
The full detail is in the [terms of service](https://www.sportmonks.com/terms-of-service/) and the terms are what govern. This is the short version, so you can check your plan against it in a minute instead of a meeting.
Go ahead

...

## Measured, not promised
### Reporting a vulnerability or a suspected breach
If you have found a security issue in our API, dashboard or website, email [support@sportmonks.com](mailto:support@sportmonks.com) with enough detail to reproduce it. Reports are handled confidentially and with priority. Median first reply across all support email is under two hours in working hours, 7 days a week, and it comes from a named person rather than an auto-reply.

...

## A short checklist for integrating securely
### Respect the rate limit and back off properly
Handle `429` responses with exponential backoff rather than an immediate retry loop, and cache what does not change every second. Current limits are documented in the [API docs](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/) .
✓

...

### When you do ask us, send these six things
[Read the documentation](https://docs.sportmonks.com/football/) [Ask a question](https://www.sportmonks.com/contact-support/)
Talk to a person

...

## Who to contact, and how fast we answer
### Data looks wrong
A score, a stat, a lineup, a missing fixture. Include the entity or fixture ID and the endpoint you called.
[support@sportmonks.com](mailto:support@sportmonks.com)

...

### Things you do not need to contact anyone about
* ✓ Generate or replace your API tokens
* ✓ Change which leagues your plan covers
* ✓ Upgrade, downgrade or cancel your plan
* ✓ Add or remove add-ons

...

### Who you are actually contracting with
[Terms of service](https://www.sportmonks.com/terms-of-service/) and [privacy policy](https://www.sportmonks.com/privacy-policy/)
Procurement and legal

...

## Still have a question this page did not answer?
* [Terms and Conditions](https://www.sportmonks.com/terms-of-service/)
* [Sitemap](https://www.sportmonks.com/sitemap/)
